# M2-A TX resampler taps (work → native)

Frozen by [M2-A G0](../../../../docs/twr/M2-A_G0接口与数字坐标.md) §3.3.
Generated by `design_m2a_tx_taps.py`:

```bash
python3 testdata/twr/m2a/taps/design_m2a_tx_taps.py
```

| direction | template | L/M | in rate | out rate | taps | DC sum | frozen file |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| tx_48_65 (UC200) | `RationalResampler48_65Core` | 48/65 | 998.4 MS/s | 737.28 MS/s | 2707 | 48 | `tx_48_65.f32` |
| tx_32_65 (CG400) | `RationalResampler32_65Core` | 32/65 | 998.4 MS/s | 491.52 MS/s | 2707 | 32 | `tx_32_65.f32` |

All files are **float32 little-endian**, raw (no header), in tap order.
The aliases live in `gr-uwb/include/gnuradio/uwb/uwb_rational_resampler_core.h`.

## Cutoff / stopband

G0 §3.3: for `<L,M>` the prototype cutoff is `virtual_rate / (2*max(L,M))`;
normalized to the virtual rate (`R_V = L*R_in`) that is `1/(2*max(L,M)) = 1/130`
for **both** `<48,65>` and `<32,65>` — the same normalized cutoff as the
existing RX directions `<65,48>` / `<65,32>`.

| direction | R_V (Hz) | cutoff (Hz) | passband | stopband | ripple | rel. stopband |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| tx_48_65 | 47923.2e6 | 368.64e6 (native Nyquist) | 330 MHz | 407.28 MHz | 0.0040 dB | **−72.25 dB** |
| tx_32_65 | 31948.8e6 | 245.76e6 (native Nyquist) | 220 MHz | 271.52 MHz | 0.0040 dB | **−72.25 dB** |

Criterion: relative stopband ≤ −70 dB, passband ripple ≤ 0.1 dB, DC sum = Interp.
Group delay = `0.5*(T−1)` virtual samples (1353) = 28.1875 / 42.28125 input
samples and 20.8154 output samples.

## (a) independent design vs (b) rescaled RX prototype

The frozen `*.f32` files are **(a)**: an independent **Remez/equiripple**
design per direction (`scipy.signal.remez`, order 2707, weight `[1,2]`),
scaled to DC = Interp. The RX prototype
`testdata/resampler_65_48/taps_quality_minorder.txt`
(sha256 `07b09983f072a06604ec08a1fee19317e010b2b10d2bf79077b6f2b6a39a2667`;
byte-identical to the 65/32 minorder file) was **not** used for the frozen
file; it is kept as **(b)** `tx_*_rescale_rx.f32` (prototype × Interp/65) so
the comparison is reproducible.

Because the normalized cutoff and transition width are identical for
`<48,65>`/`<32,65>` and `<65,48>`/`<65,32>`, the two routes describe the same
filter. Sample-by-sample difference over the common 2707 taps:

| direction | max abs (a−b) | max abs / peak | relative L2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| tx_48_65 | 2.626e-3 | 3.556e-3 | 8.666e-3 |
| tx_32_65 | 1.750e-3 | 3.556e-3 | 8.666e-3 |

The residual is the expected difference between an equiripple and a
windowed-sinc (Kaiser) realization of the same mask; both meet the frozen
mask ((a) −72.25 dB, (b) −71.98 dB). `scipy` **was available** (1.8.0), so
(a) was actually run — this is not a silent fallback.

## Core resampler fix required for these directions

The two new directions have `Decim > Interp`, which the existing RX-only
directions (`Decim < Interp`) never exercised. Two latent defects in
`RationalResamplerLmCore` were reproduced and fixed minimally in
`uwb_rational_resampler_core.h` (no-op for `Decim <= Interp`):

1. `process()` returned from the exhaustion branch **mid phase-wrap**, leaving
   `ctr_ >= Interp` (an invalid arm index) and the logical input cursor ahead
   of the consumed count.
2. `flush()` therefore mis-aligned the history and produced a wrong tail.

The fix restores `ctr_` and the cursor from
`floor(output_items_*L/M)`-consistent bookkeeping at `process()` entry and at
`flush()` entry. Evidence: independent direct upfirdn reference match for
`N = 1..8` and chunked/one-shot equivalence for all four directions, plus
unchanged 65/48 and 65/32 goldens (max_abs ≤ 3.6e-7). This is a
"necessary minimal modification" under G0 §13; the core was otherwise frozen.

## Verification

`gr-uwb/lib/qa_uwb_rational_resampler_m2a.cc` (registered by the coordinator)
covers G0 A03/A04/A05 for both new directions and both existing RX directions.
Out-of-tree build/run used during development:

```bash
/usr/bin/c++ -DBOOST_TEST_DYN_LINK -DBOOST_TEST_MAIN \
  -DUWB_TESTDATA_DIR="$PWD/testdata" \
  -I gr-uwb/include -I /usr/local/include -O2 -std=c++17 \
  -o /tmp/qa_uwb_rational_resampler_m2a \
  gr-uwb/lib/qa_uwb_rational_resampler_m2a.cc \
  -Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/lib -lboost_unit_test_framework -lvolk -lpthread -ldl -lm
env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH /tmp/qa_uwb_rational_resampler_m2a
```
